{"path":"test_case_registry.py","content":"import pytest
from case_registry import CaseRegistry

def test_different_stems_never_collide():
    """Test that two different stems never collide."""
    registry = CaseRegistry()
    
    stem1 = "test_case_1"
    stem2 = "test_case_2"
    
    result1 = registry.add(stem1)
    result2 = registry.add(stem2)
    
    # Both should be returned unchanged on first addition
    assert result1 == stem1
    assert result2 == stem2
    
    # Adding them again should produce different results
    result1_again = registry.add(stem1)
    result2_again = registry.add(stem2)
    
    # Should not collide - each should get its own suffix
    assert result1_again != result2_again

def test_first_repeat_gets_double_underscore_two():
    """Test that the first repeat of a stem gets the __2 suffix."""
    registry = CaseRegistry()
    
    stem = "test_case"
    
    # First addition - should return unchanged
    result1 = registry.add(stem)
    assert result1 == stem
    
    # Second addition - should get __2 suffix
    result2 = registry.add(stem)
    assert result2 == f"{stem}__2"

def test_second_repeat_gets_double_underscore_three():
    """Test that the second repeat of a stem gets the __3 suffix (not __2 again)."""
    registry = CaseRegistry()
    
    stem = "test_case"
    
    # First addition - should return unchanged
    registry.add(stem)
    
    # Second addition - should get __2 suffix
    result2 = registry.add(stem)
    assert result2 == f"{stem}__2"
    
    # Third addition - should get __3 suffix
    result3 = registry.add(stem)
    assert result3 == f"{stem}__3"
    
    # Verify it's not __2 again
    assert result3 != f"{stem}__2""}
